terminos.intro: Cuarto Propio is a personal space to write, collect and keep your everyday life. By using it you accept these terms, written in plain language.

secciones.texto: You need a verified email and a password to sign in. Keep your password safe: what happens inside your account is your responsibility.

Everything you write, upload or record remains yours. You only give us permission to store it and show it to you, including making lighter versions of your photos so they load fast. We don't publish it or share it with anyone.
Only keep content that is yours or that you have the right to keep. Don't use Cuarto Propio for anything illegal, and don't try to access other accounts or overload the service.

This is a personal project in its first stage, running on free plans: it may have occasional downtime and a storage limit (we'll warn you when you get close). Photos can be up to 25 MB and audio up to 50 MB or 10 minutes.
There's no trash: deleting is permanent. Data export isn't available yet.
The service is provided as is. Keep your own backups of anything important to you.
You can ask for your account and all its content to be deleted by writing to [CONTACT EMAIL].
If these terms change, the date above is updated. Important changes are announced inside the app.

privacidad.intro: What you keep here is personal and intimate. This page explains what we store, where and why. In short: only so that you can see it.

secciones.texto: Your email and password (encrypted, handled by Supabase Auth). Your name and profile photo, if you add them. Your journal entries, lists, photos (thumbnail and full size), voice notes, categories and hashtags.
Your journal draft while you write and your light or dark mode preference are saved in the browser. We only use the cookies needed to keep you signed in.
Only to show you your own content. Never to train artificial intelligence, for third-party analytics or for advertising. We don't sell or share your data.
On Supabase (database, files and authentication) and Vercel (where the app runs). Everything travels encrypted over HTTPS, and every record is protected so only your account can read it.
We only email you about your account: to confirm sign-up and to recover your password.
For as long as you have the account. What you delete is deleted permanently; the database's automatic backups renew on their own according to the provider's schedule.
You can view, correct and delete your content from the app. To delete the whole account, write to [CONTACT EMAIL].

hero.badge: A private digital sanctuary • No algorithms or likes
hero.title: A room of one’s own to write, collect, and inhabit your everyday life.
hero.subtitle: Everything currently scattered across loose notes, boards, photos, and voice memos—gathered into one intimate corner styled just the way you like.
hero.note: Installable on your phone • English & Spanish • 100% private
hero.win1Body: "Played that old record again while sipping chamomile tea. Such a relief having a place nobody else reads..."

problem.title: Your notes in one app, your photos in another, your voice memos lost in a chat…
problem.subtitle: Your daily life doesn’t live in separate silos. We bring your words, lists, photos, and voice together in one calm room.
problem.together: All kept under your own key in Cuarto Propio

mod1.title: Write like the cozy blogs of old, except just for yourself.
mod1.desc: A warm rich-text editor with bolds, headings, colors, and images. Organize entries by category, search by keyword, and revisit them chronologically.
mod1.entry1Text: Did nothing extraordinary today and yet it felt worthwhile. Jotted down three Virginia Woolf quotes in the margin.
mod1.entry2Text: Dreamt the bookshelves had tiny windows letting in the scent of salt and old paper.
mod1.entry3Title: Notes on "A Room of One’s Own"
mod1.entry3Text: "Locking the door means shutting out the noise outside to finally hear what you yourself think."

mod2.title: Keep your whims, reading lists, and daydream projects.
mod2.desc: Visual boards with checklists for "Books read", "Sunday movies", "Costumes I want to sew", or your grandmother’s recipes. Zero productivity metrics.

mod3.title: Your private gallery to exhibit your photos and artwork.
mod3.desc: Here your photos and drawings are called pieces, and pinning them to your wall is called exhibiting. Arranged in a masonry grid with hashtag filters.

mod4.title: When you don’t feel like typing, simply talk to your room.
mod4.desc: Record voice notes up to 10 minutes long to vent, capture a dream upon waking, or save the sound of rain against your window.
mod4.statusIdle: Press ▶ to hear how talking out loud to yourself feels.
mod4.statusPlaying: Playing gentle ambient chime… (Web Audio synth)

mod5.title: Your room changes with you. Try it right here.
mod5.desc: These are the themes you'll find in Customization. Scroll (or tap one) and watch your journal change; then switch the font, the accent color and the cursor.

privacy.title: It is yours. Not a social network. We never sell or train on your content.
privacy.desc: In Cuarto Propio there are no followers, no public feeds, no ads, and no algorithms demanding you post more. Everything you write, draw, photograph, or record stays under your key.

ctaFinal.title: Unlock the door to your own room.
ctaFinal.subtitle: Start today in under a minute. Install it on your phone as an app and carry it anywhere.
